mapper.select: SELECT tdm30_role_id AS role_id , tdm34_role_allc_date AS role_allc_date , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm30_person_id) AS person_name , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name FROM tdm34_role_allc_detail INNER JOIN tdm30_role_allc ON tdm30_role_allc_id = tdm34_role_allc_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm30_role_id WHERE tdm34_role_allc_detail_id = #{roleAllcDetailId} AND tdm30_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT tdm10_task_nm AS task_name , tdm12_content AS content FROM tdm12_task_relate_detail INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm12_task_id INNER JOIN tdm21_role_relate_task ON tdm21_task_id = tdm10_task_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm21_role_id WHERE tdm10_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm20_role_id = #{roleId} AND tdm12_use_yn = 'true' AND CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm10_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm10_end_date, TO_DATE('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) ORDER BY tdm10_task_nm, tdm12_seq, tdm12_content

SELECT tdm31_person_id AS person_id , tdm31_allc_std_date AS allc_std_date , tdm01_person_nm AS person_name , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name FROM tdm31_role_desc INNER JOIN LATERAL getTdm30RoleAllc(tdm31_company_id, tdm31_allc_std_date, true) ON tdm30_role_allc_id = tdm31_role_allc_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm30_role_id INNER JOIN tdm01_hr ON tdm01_person_id = tdm31_person_id WHERE tdm31_role_desc_id = #{roleDescId} AND tdm31_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT DISTINCT tdm01.tdm01_person_nm AS person_name , tdm30.tdm30_add_title_yn AS add_title_yn , tdm30.tdm30_role_id AS role_id , tdm20.tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , tdm35.tdm35_task_id AS task_id , tdm35.tdm35_task_nm AS task_name FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, CAST(#{roleStartDate} AS date), true) tdm30 LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm20_role tdm20 ON tdm30.tdm30_role_id = tdm20.tdm20_role_id LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm01_hr tdm01 ON tdm30.tdm30_person_id = tdm01.tdm01_person_id JOIN tdm35_role_allc_task tdm35 ON tdm35.tdm35_role_allc_detail_id = tdm30.tdm30_role_allc_detail_id WHERE tdm30.tdm30_person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY tdm30.tdm30_add_title_yn, tdm30.tdm30_role_id, tdm35.tdm35_task_id

WITH lists AS ( SELECT tdm20_role_id , tdm20_role_nm , tdm20_role_type , tdm20_role_type_etc_nm FROM tdm20_role WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm20_start_date <= CAST(#{allcStdDate} AS date) AND coalesce(tdm20_end_date, '2999-12-31'::date ) >= CAST(#{allcStdDate} AS date) ) SELECT tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , tdm01_person_nm AS person_name , f_Cdnm('EmpPosCode',tdm01_pos_cd, tdm01_company_id, f_today() ) AS pos_name , tdm30_add_title_yn AS add_title_yn FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, CAST(#{allcStdDate} AS date), true) LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm01_hr on tdm30_person_id = tdm01_person_id JOIN lists on tdm20_role_id = tdm30_role_id ORDER BY tdm30_role_id

SELECT CASE WHEN b.tdm33_role_digm_file_id IS NOT NULL THEN b.tdm33_role_digm_file_id ELSE a.tdm33_role_digm_file_id END FROM tdm32_role_digm LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm33_role_digm_file a ON a.tdm33_role_digm_id = tdm32_role_digm_id AND a.tdm33_file_type = '1' LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm33_role_digm_file b ON b.tdm33_role_digm_id = tdm32_role_digm_id AND b.tdm33_file_type = '2' WHERE tdm32_role_digm_id = #{roleDigmId}

SELECT tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm51_exct_id) AS exct_name , SUM(month_manl_cnt) AS month_manl_cnt , COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm53_exct_appr_yn,'false') != 'true' THEN 0 ELSE SUM(month_check1_cnt) END, 0) AS month_check1_cnt , COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm53_exct_appr_yn,'false') != 'true' THEN 0 ELSE SUM(month_check2_cnt) END, 0) AS month_check2_cnt , COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm53_exct_appr_yn,'false') != 'true' THEN 0 ELSE SUM(month_check9_cnt) END, 0) AS month_check9_cnt , COALESCE(SUM(insuff_undone_cnt) + CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm53_exct_appr_yn,'false') != 'true' THEN 0 ELSE SUM(insuff_done_cnt) END, 0) AS insuff_undone_cnt , COALESCE(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm53_exct_appr_yn,'false') != 'true' THEN 0 ELSE SUM(insuff_done_cnt) END, 0) AS insuff_done_cnt , CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm53_exct_appr_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN '점검완료' WHEN SUM(month_manl_cnt) = 0 THEN '점검대상없음' ELSE '미점검' END AS check_status_code FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm53_chck_exct ON ( tdm53_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm53_check_ym = tdm51_check_ym AND tdm53_role_id = tdm51_role_id ) INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm51_role_id INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) month_manl_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('','10','11') AND tdm52_check_result_cd = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_check1_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('','10','11') AND tdm52_check_result_cd = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_check2_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('','10','11') AND tdm52_check_result_cd = '9' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_check9_cnt FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id ) tdm52 ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN tdm54_status_cd IN ('10','11') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) insuff_done_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm54_status_cd IN ('10','11') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) insuff_undone_cnt FROM tdm54_chck_insuff WHERE tdm54_company_id = tdm53_company_id AND tdm54_role_id = tdm53_role_id AND tdm54_org_id = tdm51_org_id AND tdm54_occ_ym != tdm51_check_ym AND 'Y' = (CASE WHEN tdm54_action_appr_ym < tdm51_check_ym THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) ) tdm54 ON TRUE WHERE tdm51_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm51_check_ym = #{checkYm} AND tdm20_ceo_role_id = #{ceoRoleId} GROUP BY tdm20_role_nm, tdm51_exct_id, tdm53_exct_appr_yn ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT file.sys10_file_id FROM ( SELECT * FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} UNION SELECT sys10_file.* FROM sys11_relate_file INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys11_file_id WHERE sys11_parent_id = #{parentId} ) AS file ORDER BY COALESCE(sys10_file_yn, 'false') ASC, LPAD(COALESCE(sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys11_relate_file ( sys11_relate_file_id, sys11_file_id, sys11_parent_id, sys11_parent_table ) VALUES ( #{relateFileId}, #{fileId}, #{apprId}, 'apr01_appr' )
